On-Time Rate by Shipping Mode

Standard Class outperforms every "faster" tier
01 · PERFORMANCE
First Class delivers 0% on time — every First Class order in the dataset arrived later than scheduled, while Standard Class hit 60.2%. The promised lead time is likely set unrealistically tight for expedited tiers.

Delay Risk Driver — Feature Importance

Random Forest classifier · target: Late_delivery_risk
03 · RISK MODEL
Scheduling policy, not geography, drives delay risk. "Days for Shipment (Scheduled)" and "Shipping Mode" together account for ~84% of model importance — order region, category, and customer segment barely matter.
